extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology; qualitative/assay-class claims only, no figure digitization.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Dicentracin-like and Moronecidin are amphipathic cationic peptides with predicted alpha-helical structural features.

source_locator.locator: xml:table=1; xml:fig=1; supp:S1 Fig; supp:S2 Fig

mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural prediction supports AMP-like features but is not by itself a direct killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Both peptides show source-supported in vitro antimicrobial activity in broth microdilution MIC assays; salt can reduce activity outside physiological salt conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC and salt-tolerance assays establish activity phenotype, not a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cell-based fluorometric ELISA assays support bacterial binding comparisons under pH and salt conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure captions and result text support binding directionality; exact plot values are not digitized.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Antiadhesive and antibiofilm effects are supported by crystal-violet surface attachment and biofilm assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not convert antibiofilm phenotype into a molecular mechanism beyond the assay scope.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hemolysis testing on human red blood cells supports a toxicity/selectivity caution, but source/database assignment conflicts remain visible.
mechanism_claims.limitations: HC50 value assignment is preserved as caution because primary wording and database interpretation conflict.
